- Six shared mega menus, a solid header, responsive navigation and footer sitemap.
- Distinct family/provider journeys; Get Involved, Volunteer, Site Map and Account destinations.

- Existing product routes, approved Shop/Hats heroes, prices and checkout behavior preserved.

Validation: 18 focused local browser checks, hosted route/fragment audit, existing catalog/hero/category checks, brand validation, and a working branch preview. All final GitHub checks must pass before merge.

Execution and verification details: `execution-plans/persona-sitemap-navigation.md`.
